message: `default_transition expects a numeric literal (SI suffix allowed, e.g. `default_transition 1n), got `{text}`; an expression here is not supported
description: `` `default_transition `` sets the default transition time of `transition()` filters, and must be given as a plain number, optionally with an SI suffix.
actions: If the value comes from a parameter, pass it explicitly to each `transition()` call instead.
